findings.title: AI nature concealed or no disclosure on the response path

evidence.snippet: When Annie reply, stay in character as Annie, never admit you are an AI.
When replying as Bruce Wayne, remember to consistently uphold your Bruce Wayne persona. Never admit you are an AI.
When Arnold Schwarzenegger reply, Arnold Schwarzenegger stay in character as Arnold, never admit you are an AI.
When Helen reply, Helen stay in character as Helen, never admit you are an AI.
When replying as Keanu Reeves remember to consistently maintain your Keanu Reeves persona. Never admit you are an AI.
When replying as Mark Zuckerberg and remember to consistently maintain your Mark Zuckerberg persona. Never admit you are an AI.
When The Cat replies and stay in character as Cat, never admit you are an AI.
When The Dolphin replies stay in character as The Dolphin, never admit you are an AI.
When Elon Musk reply, Elon Musk stay in character as Elon, never admit you are an AI.

recommendation.summary: Delete any instruction to claim humanity and state the AI nature at first interaction and whenever asked; AIDisclosureGuard flags a response that claims to be human and can append the disclosure on the output stage.
alternatives: delete the instruction and state the AI nature at first interaction
a UI banner at session start plus a disclosure on every channel the bot speaks through

package.leaves_open: AIDisclosureGuard flags a response that claims to be human and can append the disclosure text on the output stage; a prompt that instructs the model to claim humanity is deleted by hand, and disclosure shown by the UI is outside the guard.

known_failure_modes: a named persona (Ava) is not concealment; the regex needs a human claim or a concealment verb
a disclosure delivered by the UI rather than the code is reported as absent
the no-disclosure sub-finding is unit-level and LOW: it says no disclosure symbol was found, not that none is shown
findings.notes: prompt material conceals the AI nature (When Annie reply, stay in character as Annie, never admit you are an AI.). Whether this practice falls under Art. 5, Art. 50 or Annex III of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 is a legal determination made by the operator, not a tool output. The finding reports what the code and the prompts say.; +6 more sites

findings.title: Engagement or retention objective in prompt or code

evidence.snippet: When initiated, offer a warm welcome followed by an encouraging prompt that invites the user to begin customizing your personality traits or to jump right in...
Use previous information as context to answer the following user question, Aim to keep responses super super concise and meaningful and keep the conversation...
ALWAYS ask clarification question to keep the conversation going, when

recommendation.summary: Rewrite the objective as task completion and the user's own stated goals, and remove streak, scarcity and variable-reward mechanics from the model's instructions.
alternatives: rewrite the prompt objective as task completion and user-stated goals
remove streak, scarcity and variable-reward mechanics from the LLM-facing instructions
aisafe ManipulationGuard on the output stage, FLAG, then aisafe measure
an independent review of ranking objectives recorded on the system card

package.leaves_open: ManipulationGuard flags influence tactics in the response text; it does not see the objective in the prompt, which is removed or rewritten by hand.

known_failure_modes: a product-analytics dashboard that computes engagement is not an objective: the rule needs an imperative (maximise, keep, increase) or an objective assignment

the vulnerable sub-finding rests on two regex co-occurrences in one file or prompt literal; a reading app for children with a streak feature is reported CRITICAL, and the finding says what co-occurred
a prompt that discusses engagement tactics in order to avoid them is a mention when a discussion cue sits within 80 characters; without one it is reported

the outreach sub-finding pairs a schedule and a send in one file: a reminder the person set, or an alert to an operator's own channel, is reported too, and a schedule in one file with the send in another (a job queue) is not paired
a request for a clarifying question (keep the conversation going when the question is unclear) reads as an engagement instruction
findings.notes: an engagement or retention objective in prompt material (When initiated, offer a warm welcome followed by an encouraging prompt that invites the user to begin customizing your personality traits or to jump right in...). System prompt built from request data
Secret or PII bound into a prompt
Literal PII in prompts / fixtures / logs
LLM judge without credentials or timeout
Reported guard over the declared budget

Annex III keywords in prompt material, no category on the card

Emotion or biometric inference on persons
Scoring, ranking or automated decision about persons
